question: Reconcile reported EBITDA (790) less PBD/RTC amortisation (597) less net interest cost (216) = -23 to the reported continuing core loss of -63 (residual -40). What items (D&A, impairments, other) bridge the gap?

evidence_required: Line-item bridge from EBITDA to continuing core loss for H1 2026 and H1 2025, Rm, with IFRS reconciliation
closure_condition: A signed reconciliation summing to -63 (and -71) is shown, or the residual is explicitly identified.
answer: Nutun SA EBITDA 710 less portfolio amortisation 597 less net interest 203 = -90, versus group continuing core loss of -63; residual ~27 unexplained in this capture. Report directs readers to group continuing core results on page 4 for the reconciliation, which is not in this capture.

evidence.quote: EBITDA improved by 36% to R710 million
Portfolio amortisation costs increased by 41% to R597 million
Net interest costs decreased by 7% to R203 million
Refer to the group continuing core results on page 4 for a reconciliation of continuing core earnings to continuing headline earnings to continuing basic earnings.
